$comment: A1 §7 ledger entry (DP-4). Field-level write partition: user-section creation = user; research/observatory creation + support/echoes/dedup = verifier; status transitions = director (user override). echoes make every support increment traceable — never a bare counter. D8 is RATIFIED as inform-don't-block. The union screen is its mechanical realization, not a supersession: the create SURFACES candidates and requires an explicit disposition from the same authorized caller (--dedup-distinct with dedup_log events, or abandon-and-echo) — nothing is refused, nothing ever auto-merges, the decision is merely made explicit and traceable by the authority who was going to make it anyway. If the screen ever blocks legitimate flow in live use, that is a revisit-D8-realization signal to surface, never a rule to route around.
